meta.title: PWA update plan - refinement proposals collected from other components
meta.status_note: Proposal only. Collected from the Admin Console plan (on hold after AC9); to be converted into a comprehensive PWA plan later. Nothing here is scheduled or built.
meta.format: Machine-readable. raw_text is the source recommendation verbatim; proposal is a first, unreviewed suggestion.
decisions_from_owner_2026_11_12: No part of backend, admin console or PWA goes to a test run until the whole plan is complete (PD-03). Test-related items below therefore wait for the full test run.
The business web app (cp-web-portal) starts at AC11 (OQ-09), which triggers the shared-package extraction.

items.raw_text: When the business web app (cp-web-portal) starts, extract the BFF core (session, oauth, dpop, private_key_jwt, forwarder, csrf), the typed client and the design-system kit from pwa/ and frontend/admin-console/ into shared packages instead of making a third copy.
items.proposal: Extract the framework-free BFF core out of pwa/src/server/bff (session store port, oauth client, dpop, private_key_jwt signer, forwarder with registry allowlist, csrf, http/header hygiene, auth-proxy, redis), the typed client (src/lib/api) and the ported design-system kit (src/components/ds) into shared packages under shared/, consumed by pwa, admin-console and cp-web-portal. Keep per-app config, session lifetimes, cookies, callback checks and allowlist source outside the shared core.
known_pwa_context: The admin console copy carries provenance headers that point back to these files.
open_questions: Package manager layout: shared/ is not a pnpm workspace today (each app has its own lockfile, GD-01 of the console).
Versioning and release of the shared packages.
Order: extract from pwa first, or from the console (which has the aal3 and purpose/reason additions)?

items.raw_text: At the next PWA stage run its pnpm test:int and pnpm e2e once against the backend at contract 1.3.0 (AC2 changed only generated types, three version strings and one template list in pwa/, checked by its unit tests, lint and contract:check).
items.trigger: full test run (after the whole plan is complete)
items.proposal: Run pnpm test:int and pnpm e2e once against the strict backend at the newest contract version (1.4.0 or later, after the backend refinement), and fix whatever the contract changes since 1.2.0/1.3.0 broke. After 1.3.0 the PWA was only checked by unit tests, lint and contract:check.
known_pwa_context: pwa/package.json: test:int = vitest run --project integration; e2e = pnpm build && playwright test

items.raw_text: Put the integration-test settings of README "Integration tests" into backend/.env (or a small script) so pnpm test:int of the console and of the PWA run against one strict backend without hand-set variables; the console test creates one ADM account per run in the dev database (bff-int-…@staff.carpals.test), harmless but visible in `pnpm dev:staff list`.
items.proposal: Define one source for the integration-test environment (strict auth flag, client keys, ports) so pwa and admin-console tests run against one strict backend without hand-set variables: either documented keys in backend/.env (with backend/.env.example entries) or a small script that exports them. The PWA side needs its test:int and e2e commands to read that source.
open_questions: Keep secrets (client private keys) in a git-ignored local file the commands source (also R-20 of the console)?
Script location: backend/tools, a root script, or per app?
related: R-04 (root script that runs both apps checks)

items.raw_text: Three BFF copies now share most code (PWA, console, later the portal): extract them when cp-web-portal starts (R-01). The console copy differs in config, session lifetimes and cookies, the aal3/staff checks of the callback, the allowlist source and the purpose/reason headers; everything else (crypto, csrf, http, dpop, token client, redis, auth proxy) is the same.
items.proposal: Same work as R-01, seen from the BFF side: the three BFF copies differ only in config, session lifetimes and cookies, the aal3/staff checks of the callback, the allowlist source and the purpose/reason headers. Track as one extraction task with R-01; the PWA keeps its guest/anonymous token handling and cp-ssr as app-level code.

items.raw_text: PWA: check its notFound() pages in the production build (pnpm e2e on :3100). The PWA's P3 note says the not-found body is drawn on the client; under the enforced Trusted Types CSP the console found that draw blocked (blank page, D-26). If the PWA shows the same, render the not-found state in the page there too, or give the error shell a policy.
items.proposal: In the production build with the enforced Trusted Types CSP, open a not-found route and check the page is not blank. If it is, render the not-found body in the page itself (server-rendered) or give the error shell a Trusted Types policy, as the console did.
known_pwa_context: Related console deviation D-26: No-permission and not-found are states the console page renders inside the shell (status 200), not forbidden()/notFound() (403/404): in Next.js 16.4.3 either one thrown by a page escapes the server render, the response is an empty <html id="__next_error__"> shell drawn on the client, and the enforced Trusted Types CSP blocks that draw (no 'default' policy without the root layout's head): a blank page. The server still refuses every call the role may not make.

items.raw_text: Publish the region tile host (WP1/WP8) before the pilot and set CARPAL_ADMIN_MAP_STYLE_URL in the console (and the PWA's style URL): without a basemap, staff correcting a pin see the pins on a blank map and must rely on the typed coordinates and the distance.
items.proposal: After the region tile host is published (WP1/WP8, backend/infra), set the PWA map style URL (CARPAL_PWA_MAP_STYLE_URL, deploy env) and the console one (CARPAL_ADMIN_MAP_STYLE_URL). Check the PWA CSP picks up the tile origins and that region config (map.style_url, map.tiles_url) matches. Without it the PWA falls back to the built-in style without a basemap.
known_pwa_context: Region config still points at cdn.carpal.app (backend NI-22, Go-live item in the console handoff notes)
open_questions: Final tile host name and who publishes it.
Should the PWA read the style only from region config and drop the env override?
